# 🍱 WikiBento demos

WikiBento is a drag-and-drop dashboard for Wikimedia — a single place for keeping an eye on things and acting on them. Wikimedia's data and activity live across many places: pageview and stats APIs, wiki pages, recent changes, Commons. WikiBento brings what you care about into one place — starting with metrics like article pageviews, external link counts, category sizes, file usage, and GLAM-style impact stats.

Start small, then go deep. Every board is a JSON config you can copy, edit, and share.

**Onboarding**

- [👋 Article switcher](?config=/article-switcher-demo.json) — the simplest board: one param, two cards
- [🔤 Biosphere levels](?config=/biosphere-demo.json) — every label in a diagram is clickable; the words came out of the picture by OCR
- [📷 Steam turbine, labelled](?config=/turbine-demo.json) — every label in a power-plant diagram is a door: the words were read out of the drawing by OCR, and a click loads the article *and* its traffic
- [✈️ Aircraft lifecycles](?config=/aircraft-lifecycle-demo.json) — six aircraft bars you can click: the bars were found by pixel scan, not by eye, and each opens the aircraft's article and its traffic
- [👆 Clickable zones](?config=/zone-demo.json) — a photograph whose own Commons notes are clickable; a click loads that peak's article beside it(?config=/zone-demo.json) — a photograph whose own Commons notes are clickable; a click loads that peak's article beside it
- [🖼️ Image tour](?config=/image-tour-demo.json) — three views of one ridge, **chained by zones**: a click loads the next picture with its own zones already in place
- [🌐 Translate chain](?config=/translate-demo.json) — two params, a widget that feeds another widget
- [🎞️ Commons gallery](?config=/gallery-demo.json) — Commons' curated layer as data: hand-written captions in hand-chosen order, and a click that drives the reader beside it
- [🗂️ Category gallery](?config=/category-images-demo.json) — the same file gallery, with the file list coming from a Commons category; alphabetical, newest, random or largest
- [🔎 Page picker](?config=/page-picker-demo.json) — one box, a wiki beside it, and three cards that follow (ISSUE-99)
- [🎛️ Params & galleries](?config=/params-demo.json) — buttons, a slider, a month stepper
- [🔀 Dataflow pipeline](?config=/flow-demo.json) — Text List → Filter → Count → Display

**Flagships**

- [🏛️ One template, five institutions](?config=/glam-demo.json) — exact GLAM impact stats, switch collections
- [⚖️ A Wikimedian in Residence, four years in](?config=/wipo-wir-demo.json) — WIPO × Wikimedia: three residents in four languages, the exact impact of their Commons uploads, and the core articles' coverage per language
- [🔎 Article vitals](?config=/article-vitals-demo.json) — summary, traffic, quality, projects, edits, images
- [🧠 Query power](?config=/sparql-demo.json) — live SPARQL across WDQS, Humaniki and QLever
- [📖 Internet Archive](?config=/internet-archive-demo.json)
- [🎞 Story mode](?config=/story-demo.json)
- [📰 A wiki page in a card](?config=/wiki-page-demo.json) — any wiki page rendered in a card (the lead, a section, or all of it), with every blue link a pick target — one Wikipedia article as a continuous scroll: the images, their captions, and the article's own chapters — a book you can read, zoom and search inside; an archive item per media type
- [📄 Read a document](?config=/document-reader-demo.json) — a 329-page PDF and a DjVu from Wikimedia Commons beside an Internet Archive book: one reader, two archives
- [🖌 One image filling the box](?config=/image-tile-demo.json) — a single file as a full-bleed tile, letterboxed or cropped, and the Frame switch that removes the chrome
- [🖼️ Edge to edge](?config=/edge-to-edge-demo.json) — the switch that takes a card’s chrome away, on a QR code, a Commons document, an IA book and an embedded 3D model
- [🗺️ Maps](?config=/map-demo.json) — a place as a card, and any number of points on it: coordinates, Wikidata items or page titles, framed to fit, drawn by Wikimedia’s own map service

**Flagships**

- [📰 The front page, as boxes](?config=/front-page-demo.json) — In the news, Did you know, On this day and the day's featured article and picture: five Wikipedia templates, rendered with the wiki's own styles

**Interactive**

- [👆 Click through](?config=/click-through-demo.json) — click a sea in a live `List of seas` box and the page viewer beside it loads that article; the string that travelled is shown as a value

**Also**

- [📄 Embed any page](?config=/embed-demo.json) — frame a 3D model (Objectium) in a card
- [🧩 Full catalog](?config=/dashboard.json) — all 36 widget types on one board

> Every board also works in kiosk mode: add `?kiosk=1`.
- 🕰️ **[Two lives, one axis](?config=/parallel-lives-demo.json)** — Anne Frank and Martin Luther King Jr. on a shared timeline: both born 1929, one life ending where the other had barely begun. _(ISSUE-78)_
- [🌍 Born in 1929](?config=/anne-frank-mlk-demo.json) — two lives on one axis, with the prose, the pictures and the traffic for each: Anne Frank and Martin Luther King Jr.
